scanNote:
PHOTO FILE - UNIT 14 (raqamsiz bet, pdf 157). Qirqib olinadigan karta. Yuqorida to'q sariq 'UNIT 14'.

IKKI SURAT va QAYDLAR:
1-SURAT (ko'k fon): yaguar daryo bo'yida o'tlar orasida. QAYD 'Jaguar': Where found: the Amazon rainforest, S. America. Characteristics: 3rd largest cat in the world - weigh more than 300 pounds. Why endangered: hunted for its skin - natural habitat disappearing. Suggested solutions: make hunting illegal - create reserves where they can live safely. O'ngda 16 ta bo'sh qator.
2-SURAT (sariq fon): Afrika fili va bolasi savannada. QAYD 'African Elephant': Where found: Africa. Characteristics: largest land animal - can weigh more than six tonnes. Why endangered: hunted for its ivory. Suggested solutions: control ivory trade - educate people about the problem. Chapda 16 ta bo'sh qator.

⚠ Bu 101-betdagi Writing (Project) uchun shablon: 'Use the notes in the Photo File section to write two short articles about the jaguar and the African elephant.'

exercises.instructionEn: Read the notes. Jaguar - Where found: the Amazon rainforest, S. America. Characteristics: 3rd largest cat in the world - weigh more than 300 pounds. Why endangered: hunted for its skin - natural habitat disappearing. Suggested solutions: make hunting illegal - create reserves where they can live safely. African Elephant - Where found: Africa. Characteristics: largest land animal - can weigh more than six tonnes. Why endangered: hunted for its ivory. Suggested solutions: control ivory trade - educate people about the problem.
exercises.instructionUz: Qaydlarni o'qing. Yaguar - Qayerda: Amazonka tropik o'rmoni, Janubiy Amerika. Xususiyatlari: dunyodagi 3-eng katta mushuk - 300 funtdan og'ir. Nega xavf ostida: terisi uchun ovlanadi - tabiiy yashash muhiti yo'qolmoqda. Taklif qilingan yechimlar: ovni noqonuniy qilish - xavfsiz yashaydigan qo'riqxonalar yaratish. Afrika fili - Qayerda: Afrika. Xususiyatlari: eng katta quruqlik hayvoni - olti tonnadan og'ir. Nega xavf ostida: fil suyagi uchun ovlanadi. Taklif qilingan yechimlar: fil suyagi savdosini nazorat qilish - odamlarni muammo haqida ma'lumotli qilish.
exercises.explanationUz:
IKKI HAYVON - TO'RT SARLAVHA
(99-bet matnlari kabi):

  JAGUAR (yaguar):
    qayerda - Amazonka tropik
      o'rmoni, Janubiy Amerika
    xususiyat - dunyoda 3-eng katta
      mushuk, 300+ funt (136 kg)
    xavf sababi - terisi uchun ov;
      yashash muhiti yo'qolmoqda
    yechim - ovni taqiqlash;
      qo'riqxonalar

  AFRICAN ELEPHANT (Afrika fili):
    qayerda - Afrika
    xususiyat - eng katta quruqlik
      hayvoni, 6+ tonna
    xavf sababi - fil suyagi uchun ov
    yechim - fil suyagi savdosini
      nazorat qilish; odamlarni
      o'qitish


⚠ 'CHARACTERISTICS':

  = xususiyatlar.


⚠ 'A POUND':

  = funt (0,45 kg).


⚠ 'NATURAL HABITAT':

  = tabiiy yashash muhiti.


⚠ 'A RESERVE':

  = qo'riqxona.


⚠ 'IVORY':

  = fil suyagi.
  ⚠ 'the ivory trade' = fil suyagi
  savdosi.


⚠ 'TO EDUCATE':

  = o'qitmoq, ma'lumotli qilmoq.

exercises.instructionEn: Use the notes to write two short articles about the jaguar and the African elephant (Unit 14, Writing Project, p. 101). Use the texts on p. 99 as models.
exercises.instructionUz: Qaydlardan foydalanib yaguar va Afrika fili haqida ikkita qisqa maqola yozing (14-unit, Yozuv loyihasi, 101-bet). 99-betdagi matnlardan namuna sifatida foydalaning.
exercises.explanationUz:
MAQOLA QOLIPI (99-bet):
  1 Qayerda uchraydi + xususiyat
  2 Nega xavf ostida
  3 Taklif (In my opinion, ...
    should ...)

  ⚠ MAJHUL: 'is found', 'is hunted'.
  ⚠ 'should be + V3': 'hunting
  should be made illegal'.

structure.modelEn: The jaguar is found in the Amazon rainforest in South America. It is the third largest cat in the world and it can weigh more than 300 pounds. Jaguars are facing extinction because they are hunted for their skin and their natural habitat is disappearing. In my opinion, hunting should be made illegal and reserves should be created where jaguars can live safely.
structure.modelUz: Yaguar Janubiy Amerikadagi Amazonka tropik o'rmonida uchraydi. U dunyodagi uchinchi eng katta mushuk va vazni 300 funtdan ortiq bo'lishi mumkin. Yaguarlar yo'qolib ketish xavfida, chunki ular terisi uchun ovlanadi va tabiiy yashash muhiti yo'qolmoqda. Mening fikrimcha, ov noqonuniy deb e'lon qilinishi va yaguarlar xavfsiz yashaydigan qo'riqxonalar yaratilishi kerak.

structure.modelEn: The African elephant is found in Africa. It is the largest land animal in the world and it can weigh more than six tonnes. African elephants are in danger of becoming extinct because they are hunted for their ivory. I believe that the ivory trade should be controlled and people should be educated about the problem.
structure.modelUz: Afrika fili Afrikada uchraydi. U dunyodagi eng katta quruqlik hayvoni va vazni olti tonnadan ortiq bo'lishi mumkin. Afrika fillari yo'qolib ketish xavfi ostida, chunki ular fil suyagi uchun ovlanadi. Menimcha, fil suyagi savdosi nazorat qilinishi va odamlar muammo haqida ma'lumotli qilinishi kerak.
